title: Annotation Task
description: Defines the required metadata for every annotation task in the Sauti Labs platform, per the Master Blueprint's Annotation Platform (Pillar III). Tracks the annotation process itself as an auditable step between raw data and a ready dataset.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this annotation task, e.g. 'kiswahili-broadcast-transcription-batch-01'.

dataset_id.description: Cross-reference to the dataset-framework entry this annotation task produces or improves.

source_id.description: Optional cross-reference to a corpus-registry entry, if annotating a text source.

contributor_ids.description: Identifiers of contributors who performed or reviewed this task.

items_annotated.description: Count of items (utterances, sentences, documents) annotated in this task.

quality_score.description: Quality score out of 100, from consensus validation or review.

inter_annotator_agreement.description: Agreement score between multiple annotators, if applicable, e.g. Cohen's kappa.
